title: The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn't A Guy at All Anime's 1st Promo Video Reveals More Cast/Staff, January 8 Premiere
content:
Aniplex unveiled on Friday the first promotional video, more cast and staff, and January 8 premiere for the anime adaptation of Sumiko Arai 's The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn't a Guy at All ( Ki ni Natteru Hito ga Otoko Janakatta ) manga:

Crunchyroll streamed an English-subtitled trailer at New York Comic Con :

The newly announced cast includes:

Kōsuke Noma and Takayuki "Kojiro" Sasaki are composing the music.

The anime will debut on January 8 at 11:00 p.m. JST on NTV 's FuraAni programming block.

The cast includes Akari Kitō as Aya Ōsawa, and Mariya Ise as Mitsuki Koga .

Masashi Ishihama ( From the New World , Garakowa -Restore the World- , Horimiya ) is directing the anime. CloverWorks will animate the series. Rino Yamazaki ( Akebi's Sailor Uniform , The Fragrant Flower Blooms With Dignity , Spy×Family season 3) is in charge of series composition. Kanna Hirayama ( Rent-A-Girlfriend , Oshi no Ko ) is designing the characters.

The opening theme is the 1991 song "Breed" by grunge band Nirvana.

Yen Press licensed the manga and released the third volume in December 2025. Yen Press describes the manga's story:

Fashionable and upbeat high schooler Aya falls head over heels for an employee at a local CD shop. He's got an air of mystery about him, great style, and an impeccable music taste. Little does she know—this supposedly male employee is actually her female classmate Mitsuki! Mitsuki generally keeps to herself, but since her seat is right next to Aya's, she can't help but be extremely aware of the other's crush. Revealing the truth is out of the question for Mitsuki—but perhaps getting closer to Aya wouldn't be so bad…

Arai launched the series as a manga on Twitter (later known as X) in April 2022 before serializing on pixiv Comic in April 2023. Kadokawa Shoten publishes the series in print and shipped the fourth compiled book volume on February 19.

The series ranked #2 on the 23rd annual Da Vinci "Book of the Year" list and #2 for top manga for female readers on the 2024 edition of Takarajimasha 's Kono Manga ga Sugoi! (This Manga Is Amazing!) guidebook .
author: ANN

title: Here U Are Anime Reveals 2nd Teaser Trailer
content:
Crunchyroll revealed during its panel at the New York Comic Con 2026 on Thursday the second teaser trailer for the anime adaptation of D JUN 's Here U Are webtoon. The video features a score by the anime's musical composer and Japanese pianist Shinya Kiyozuka .

Yang Yu is a university upperclassman who's loved by everyone, and Huan Li is a quiet, antisocial new student. The two of them get off on the wrong foot, but despite clashing and repelling one another at times, they are still drawn to each other.

The anime stars Yūki Inoue as Yang Yu and Ryōta Suzuki as Huan Li.

Tomoe Makino ( Aharen-san wa Hakarenai ) will direct the anime at Rouseact . Aiki Kawamura is handling the series composition. Asami Hayakawa is designing the characters. Shinya Kiyozuka is composing the music.

The webtoon originally debuted in 2017, and it ended in 2020. Aloha Comics releases the series in English. The webtoon is also available on WEBTOON .

The webtoon has over 390 million total views worldwide as of April 2026.
author: ANN

title: Gundam Seed Freedom Zero Prequel Anime's Trailer Reveals Theatrical Release in Japan on January 15, N. America in February 2027
content:
A livestream for Mobile Suit Gundam Seed FREEDOM ZERO , the prequel to the Mobile Suit Gundam Seed FREEDOM anime film, unveiled on Friday a trailer, and it announces that the film will open in theaters in Japan on January 15 and in North America in February 2027.

The cast (which features returning members) includes:

• Kenichi Suzumura as Shinn Asuka

• Maaya Sakamoto as Lunamaria Hawke

• Houko Kuwashima as Agnes Giebenrath

• Daisuke Ono as Leonard Valway

• Sōichirō Hoshi as Kira Yamato

• Rie Tanaka as Lacus Clyne

• Akira Ishida as Athrun Zala

• Nanako Mori as Cagalli Yula Athha

• Tomokazu Seki as Yzak Jule

• Akira Sasanuma as Dearka Elthman

• Kotono Mitsuishi as Murrue Ramius

• Takehito Koyasu as Mu La Flaga

The staff includes:

• Planning/Production: SUNRISE

• Original Concept: Hajime Yatate, Yoshiyuki Tomino

• Director: Mitsuo Fukuda

• Screenplay: Shigeru Morita, Chiaki Morosawa, Mitsuo Fukuda

• Character Design/Animation Director: Hisashi Hirai

• Mechanical Animation Director: Satoshi Shigeta

• Mechanical Design: Kunio Ōkawara, Kimitoshi Yamane, Manabu Shintani, zenseava, Takuya Io

• Color Design:Akemi Nagao

• Art Director: Shigemi Ikeda, Yukiko Maruyama

• CG Director: Mitsuhiro Sato, Kensuke Kushida

• Monitor Graphics: Azusa Tamura, Jirō Kageyama

• Director of Photography: Takeshi Katsurayama, Ryō Iijima

• Offline Editing: Yukiko Nojiri

• Sound Director: Sadayoshi Fujino

• Music: Toshihiko Sahashi

• Production: Bandai Namco Filmworks

• Distribution: Bandai Namco Filmworks, Shochiku Co. Ltd.

Director Mitsuo Fukuda , producer Hisakazu Naka , and Sōichirō Hoshi , voice of Kira Yamato, appeared at a stage greeting during the first screening announcing the prequel. They revealed that screenwriter Chiaki Morosawa and Shigeru Morita wrote the prequel's scenario while planning for Gundam Seed Freedom itself. In addition, Fukuda stated that the script for Gundam Seed FREEDOM ZERO was completed 20 years ago.

Gundam Seed FREEDOM ZERO's storyboards were nearly half finished, and the oldest storyboards actually predate those of Gundam Seed Freedom itself. The dialogue recording has also already been completed. Fukuda added that 20 years ago, Gundam Seed FREEDOM ZERO was originally planned as an original video anime ( OVA ), but the staff has not yet decided how it will be presented now.

Mobile Suit Gundam Seed FREEDOM opened in Japan in January 2024. The film debuted at #1 in the Japanese box office. It sold 634,182 tickets for 1,065,983,130 yen (about US$7.20 million) in its first three days, marking the Gundam franchise 's highest three-day opening in box office earnings. The film is the highest-earning Gundam film in Japan ever.

Bandai Namco Filmworks and Fathom Events screened the film in the United States and Canada in May 2024. Netflix is streaming the film .

Special editions of the film screened in theaters in Japan in fall 2024. One version played with footage added to the end. Another special edition had different footage added (specifically, the above-mentioned teaser video).

Fukuda directed the film at Bandai Namco Filmworks . Fukuda also co-wrote the script along with his late wife Chiaki Morosawa and Liu Goto . Hisashi Hirai ( Mobile Suit Gundam Seed ) designed the characters.
author: ANN

title: The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn't a Guy At All First Trailer and New Cast Revealed, January 8 Premiere
content:
The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn’t a Guy At All anime revealed the first trailer, more voice cast, and a January 8, 2027 premiere date. The anime previously revealed new character visuals for Mitsuki and Aya. The adaptation was announced in February, while the studio and theme song were announced during Anime Expo in July.

The anime will have Nirvana’s “Breed” as the opening theme song, as revealed by Dave Grohl himself. Masashi Ishihama is directing at studio CloverWorks. The main voice cast includes Mariya Ise as Mitsuki Koga and Akari Kito as Aya Osawa. You can see the new visuals below.

The Guy She Was Interested in Wasn’t a Guy at All , often shortened to KiniOto or TGSWIIWAGAA and widely recognized by fans as the “Green Yuri” because of its recognizable green visual style, is a Japanese manga created by Sumiko Arai. The series first appeared as a short story shared on Arai’s Twitter account between July and September 2021. It later returned as a weekly web manga in April 2022 before being serialized on Pixiv Comic in April 2023. That same month, Media Factory began publishing the series in print, and as of February 2026, four collected volumes were released. In 2023, it won the Next Manga Award in the web manga category.

Crunchyroll describes the story: Fashionable and upbeat high schooler Aya loves listening to rock, but no one else seems to share her interest…until she meets a cool, stylish employee at a CD shop. Dressed in black from head to toe, he has this air of mystery about him, and his taste in music is impeccable. Aya falls hard for him—not knowing her crush is actually her female classmate Mitsuki! For her part, Mitsuki generally keeps to herself and avoids standing out at school. But given that she sits right next to Aya, Mitsuki’s all too aware of the other girl’s feelings, and she’s afraid to reveal the truth. So why does she find herself talking with Aya more and more…?
author: Anime Corner

title: Macross Frontier Anime's Blu-ray Disc Ships in 2027
content:
Big West also confirmed during its panel that The Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love? anime film's audiovisual content is part of the existing Macross franchise worldwide.

Nozomi Entertainment describes Macross Frontier :

Many years ago, the Earth was caught up in an intergalactic war. Humanity, having experienced the threat of annihilation, set out towards all corners of the galaxy in hopes of securing their future. It is now A.D. 2059. On board the Super Long-Range Emigration Fleet Macross Frontier , Ranka Lee is looking forward to an upcoming concert by superstar singer Sheryl Nome, who is visiting from the Macross Galaxy Fleet. Ranka dreams of becoming an idol singer herself one day, and on her way to the concert she bumps into Alto Saotome, a young man training to become a Variable Fighter pilot. When the concert venue is attacked by a mysterious alien species known only as the Vajra, emotions run high and a complicated relationship begins to form between the three. What is the shocking secret behind Ranka's song? More importantly, will humanity survive long enough to find out?

The Macross Frontier television anime aired in 2008 following the 25th anniversary of the Macross franchise . The Macross Frontier: Itsuwari no Utahime film premiered in 2009 as an alternate retelling, and was followed by the Macross Frontier: Sayonara no Tsubasa sequel film in 2011. The Gekijō Tanpen Macross Frontier Toki no Meikyū short ran with the Macross Delta the Movie: Absolute Live!!!!!! feature in screenings in 2021.
author: ANN

title: Dark Horse to Release Gou Tanabe's The Outsider and Other Early Adaptations Collection
content:
Dark Horse announced during its panel at New York Comic Con 2026 on Thursday that it will release Gou Tanabe 's The Outsider and Other Early Adaptations collection, with translation by Zack Davisson . The collection feature's Tanabe's manga adaptation of H.P. Lovecraft 's The Outsider story, and also includes Tanabe's early adaptations of works by Anton Chekhov and Maxim Gorky.

Dark Horse describes the collection:

Alone in a decaying castle, with no memory of its origins and no knowledge of the world beyond its crumbling stone walls, a solitary being longs for connection. Driven by an unshakable desire to see the outside world, it escapes the darkness of its prison only to discover a reality more terrifying than the isolation he left behind. Gou Tanabe ( At the Mountains of Madness , The Shadow Over Innsmouth ) brings H.P. Lovecraft 's The Outsider to life with stunning detail. In addition to this centerpiece adaptation, this collection also features his story Ju-Ga and interpretations of Anton Chekhov's The House with a Mezzanine , and Maxim Gorky's 26 Men and a Girl , showcasing Tanabe's remarkable range across literary works.

Dark Horse also announced a new Blue Eye Samurai western-style comic series titled Blue Eye Samurai: Cry of the Yurei by writers K. Perkins and Mike Johnson , and a new graphic novel titled Martial War by co-creators Hiroyuki Takei ( Shaman King manga creator), Will Carter, and Aidan White.

The Blue Eye Samurai: Cry of the Yurei comic's staff also includes artist Aviv Or, colorist Valentina Bianconi, letterer Taylor Esposito , and cover artist David Mack. Ito and Angela Wu provide the variant covers.

Takei is also the cover artist for Martial War . Jet Kusamura is the graphic novel's art assistant, Steve Dutro is the letterer, and Karen Corpuz is in charge of translation. The project is inspired by real-world moments in UFC fights, and is made in collaboration with the UFC.

Dark Horse describes the story of Martial War :

When Trash was just a helpless kid, he witnessed the incredible power of ninja at war. Now, in a country piecing itself back together, ninja no longer fight on the streets—but in a special arena known as the Octagon. Although ninja are now disgraced, they are the only ones with the power to wield the mighty Tatara stones. The Octagon is about to be shaken up when Trash crashes the tournament, ready to fight his way to the top. Will he be able to wield a Tatara stone, or will its corrosive aura kill him before he can throw a single punch? Illustrated by master manga-ka Hiroyuki Takei —creator of Shaman King —with art assistance by Jet Kusamura , and lettering by Eisner Award-nominated Steve Dutro ( Monster , 21st Century Boys , I am a Hero ). Co-created and co-written by Hiroyuki Takei , Aidan White, and Will Carter, this American-Japanese collaboration will follow a right-to-left reading order and is unlike anything else in the world of fight comics!

Dark Horse announced in August that it will release Gou Tanabe 's manga adaptation of H.P. Lovecraft 's The Case of Charles Dexter Ward horror novella in spring 2027. The semimonthly manga series is part of a series of adaptations of H.P. Lovecraft 's works by Tanabe. Dark Horse Comics published his manga of H.P. Lovecraft's The Hound and Other Stories in August 2017, which includes "The Hound," "The Temple," and "The Nameless City." Dark Horse Comics began releasing Tanabe's At the Mountains of Madness manga in June 2019. The series was nominated for Best Comic by the 46th Angoulême International Comics Festival in 2019.

Dark Horse has also released a single omnibus volume of Tanabe's The Shadow Over Innsmouth manga , and has also released Tanabe's The Call of Cthulhu manga , the latter of which won the Superior Achievement in a Graphic Novel award at the Bram Stoker Awards in June 2025. Dark Horse released Tanabe's The Colour Out of Space in July 2025, and released The Shadow Out of Time in December that same year. Dark Horse most recently released The Dunwich Horror manga on September 29.

Tanabe also released manga based on Lovecraft's The Haunter of the Dark .

Tanabe launched the Short Stories about Dreamlands manga based on H.P. Lovecraft 's Dream Cycle stories in November 2023, and ended the series in April 2024. Tanabe launched the Lovecraft no Genei (The Lovecraft's Phantom) manga in Comic Beam in June 2024, and ended it in December 2024.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action 5 Centimeters Per Second Film Screens in N. America on October 23
content:
GKIDS announced on Thursdady that it will begin screening the live-action film of Makoto Shinkai 's 5 Centimeters per Second anime film in North American theaters on October 23. GKIDS will reveal details about a home video release later this year. The company streamed an English-subtitled trailer:

SixTONES member Hokuto Matsumura ( Suzume 's Sōta Munakata) stars in the live-action film.

Spoon produced the film, and TOHO distributed. Yoshiyuki Okuyama directed, and Ayako Suzuki wrote the script. Ayatake Ezaki composed the music. Kenshi Yonezu performs the theme song "1991."

GKIDS describes the film:

After transferring to the same elementary school, Takaki and Akari became best friends. However, their lives change when both their families are forced to relocate. After a year of separation, Takaki is about to reunite with Akari. As he sits on the train from Tokyo, memories of the past rush through Takaki's head, his meeting time with Akari drawing ever closer. Takaki and Akari begin to wonder if they will ever be able to see each other again, and share their secret feelings. Join Takaki on a journey into three interconnected tales of love and lost innocence that span the minutes and months of their lives.

The 5 Centimeters per Second anime opened in Japan in 2007.

Shinkai directed, wrote, and storyboarded the anime film, and was also the sound director, producer, and art director. Tenmon composed the music.

GKIDS will reveal details about a home video release later this year. The company streamed an English-subtitled trailer:

contentBlocks.credit: Image via 5 Centimeters Per Second live-action film's X/Twitter account

contentBlocks.text: SixTONES member Hokuto Matsumura ( Suzume 's Sōta Munakata) stars in the live-action film.
Spoon produced the film, and TOHO distributed. Yoshiyuki Okuyama directed, and Ayako Suzuki wrote the script. Ayatake Ezaki composed the music. Kenshi Yonezu performs the theme song "1991."
GKIDS describes the film:

After transferring to the same elementary school, Takaki and Akari became best friends. However, their lives change when both their families are forced to relocate. After a year of separation, Takaki is about to reunite with Akari. As he sits on the train from Tokyo, memories of the past rush through Takaki's head, his meeting time with Akari drawing ever closer. Takaki and Akari begin to wonder if they will ever be able to see each other again, and share their secret feelings. Join Takaki on a journey into three interconnected tales of love and lost innocence that span the minutes and months of their lives.
The 5 Centimeters per Second anime opened in Japan in 2007.
Shinkai directed, wrote, and storyboarded the anime film, and was also the sound director, producer, and art director. Tenmon composed the music.

title: Almost 20 Years Later, Shonen Jump’s Wild Dark Series Finally Gets the Perfect Anime Adaptation
content:
2026 might be coming to an end, but it still has a whole season, Fall, left, and as the new seasons do their job, they bring new anime . Among the waves of new anime, there is one that might be especially exciting for Shonen Jump fans, as it is based on a manga that first debuted almost 20 years ago and was canceled around three years after serialization, with 100 chapters. Getting an anime adaptation for a canceled series is hardly heard of, but 2026 has proven to be very fruitful in that regard, as it has also featured another one in the previous season.

Black Torch surprised the fandom with its shonen storytelling in only 12 episodes, proving that even canceled manga can be just as good. More importantly, it proves that these manga should have gotten extended runs, especially Black Torch . But alas, the anime adaptation they received, even after being canceled, more than redeemed them. The new anime adaptation of the canceled manga that first debuted almost 20 years ago is Psyren by Toshiaki Iwashiro. The anime studio, Statelight, has given the manga a much-deserved anime adaptation, and the first episode of the series proves that it was a classic shonen anime series of the late 2000s, capturing the vibe of the era that makes this series even better.

16 Years After Its Cancellation, Shonen Jump’s Psyren Finally Gets the Perfect Anime Adaptation

Toshiaki Iwashiro’s manga, Psyren , follows a high school teenager named Ageha Yoshina, who is the perfect macho type, like Ichigo from Bleach , loving to do odd jobs, such as taking out bullies for money. It presents him as a brawler-type character who lets his muscles do all the work. The intriguing element of this series is presented through the occurrence of people receiving a phone call at a payphone, calling them to a place called “ Psyren ,” which is supposedly a paradise. Yoshina, one day, receives this call along with a mysterious red card from the payphone, which serves as the entry key for going to this place.

At first, Yoshina is pissed because he doesn’t like being ordered to enter this area, but seeing that his classmate, Amamiya, is also in the same situation and asks for his help, Yoshina eventually finds himself in this place, which is more of a hell than a paradise, filled with mysterious monsters. It is seemingly revealed that he has to take them on to survive in this world. It makes it clear that this anime is going to be built around a survival game mechanism, as Amamiya seems to be entering and exiting the world back and forth. The series will naturally follow them as they discover who is behind all of this, keeping fans engaged with its intrigue.

What stands out about Psyren ‘s anime adaptation is how it presents the perfect 2000s retro vibe, as the animation style and other elements make it feel like watching the first episodes of classic shonen anime such as Bleach . But it also looks modernized enough, with darker elements blending a sense of horror into it, while uncovering what lies beneath the game presents Psyren as a perfect shonen anime. With no other new shonen anime debuting this season, Psyren might just be the best new shonen anime of Fall 2026, proving the canceled Shonen Jump series needed an anime adaptation just as much as Black Torch did in the previous season.

title: 3 New and Returning Anime Arriving in Fall 2026’s Second Weekend That You Can’t Miss
content:
The Fall 2026 season is here, and it is already heading into its second weekend. Yet, the new and exciting anime haven’t completely arrived, as this weekend is poised to bring many new series once again. This season has already proven to be an interesting one, thanks to the variety of series that have arrived, including returning favorites and many new series. The first weekend was especially focused on several returning anime alongside great new series.

However, the second weekend’s debuts differ from what the first weekend of Fall had to offer. It will see two new anime arriving, one being a dark romantic series, while the other is a dark shonen series with the perfect premise. The final series debuting on the upcoming Sunday will actually mark the return of a beloved franchise with an intriguing project, making it something no one should miss.

3) Firefly Wedding

Starting this weekend, on Friday, October 8th, arguably one of the most distinctive anime of Fall 2026 will arrive. Firefly Wedding , based on the manga of the same name, has a popular fanbase that has been looking forward to seeing the anime adaptation, especially since the manga came to an end only a month after the anime’s announcement. It is one of the most talked-about shojo manga among fans, and it is all thanks to its premise.

The premise, featuring a fragile noblewoman on the verge of death proposing marriage to an assassin, seems very far-fetched, but their romantic blend, made up of the components that both lack, emerges as a thrilling dark romance series . What makes this anime adaptation even more exciting is David Production, the studio behind anime such as JoJo and Fire Force , which only reinforces that it will be an exciting anime that you can’t miss.

2) The Vermilion Mask

The new dark shonen anime arriving this Saturday, October 10th, 2026, is The Vermilion Mask , and out of everything on this list, this might just be the most exciting anime debut of the weekend. In fact, it wouldn’t be an overstatement to call this anime one of the best new shonen anime of Fall 2026, as it captures the perfect modern nuances that recent anime have become known for.

The Vermilion Mask features a protagonist named Peru, who is given an overpowered ability thanks to the mask his master made. However, the gravity of the power is too much for Peru to handle, and he ends up killing his master and the other apprentices. This sets the tone for Peru venturing on a journey to destroy the masks and redeem his actions. It has the dark shonen protagonist found in anime like Gachiakuta and Jujutsu Kaisen , and has the potential to stand out like them, making it an anime that fans shouldn’t miss this weekend.

1) Dragon Ball Super: Beerus

The final great anime arriving on the second weekend of Fall 2026 is actually the return of the Dragon Ball franchise, with the anime Dragon Ball Super: Beerus , on Sunday, October 11th. It was a surprise announcement earlier this year that Dragon Ball ‘s next anime would actually be a remastered version of the Dragon Ball Super series, which kicked off the God era. It has been emphasized that the decade-old anime adaptation now needs a remastered version to modernize its old animation.

However, it is also clear that the primary reason is to bring back fans of the franchise, diving into the God era so that they will be able to depict the new proper arc, Dragon Ball Super: The Galactic Patrol , which will arrive late next year. Even decades later, the Dragon Ball franchise still remains one of the top anime series ever , and Fall 2026’s second week is yet again starting something new for the franchise that will undoubtedly last for many more years to come.

title: Stunning New Vampire Anime Is The Castlevania Replacement Fans Needed
content:
With Castlevania: Nocturne having come to an end in early 2025, anime fans have been caught in a vampire drought over the last year, which is unfortunate, as the genre as come back full force thanks to the success of massive live-action properties like Nosferatu and The Vampire Lestat breaking into the mainstream. Just in time for 2027, a collaboration from ZERO-G x Liber is coming to save anime fans and bring vampires back to the forefront of the medium. Dropping a trailer, key visual, character art as well as full staff and cast information, ZERO-G x Liber has announced an anime adaptation of Kyo Shirodaira and Yuri Kimura’s The Record of a Fallen Vampire .

The series follows an ancient vampire king, King Akabara “Red Rose” Strauss, who lost his vampiric empire and queen after she was sealed away by humans. Akabara has spent thousands of years searching for his lost love, and as the story begins, he encounters the 49th Black Swan — a powerful entity who inhabits the body of a human woman, bestowing her with the power to defeat the vampire king and his queen.

The Record of a Fallen Vampire Has a Star-Studded Production Team

The Record of a Fallen Vampire hasn’t received a firm release date outside of its 2027 window just yet, however, ZERO-G x Liber have revealed who will be working on the series, and the production staff is just what the series needs to bring it to life. At the helm of the project working on series composition and lead director is Mankyu, who previously worked on the 2023 anime adaptation of Migi & Dali ; character designs for The Record of a Fallen Vampire will be handled by jimao, who worked on previous Liber projects like The Ice Guy and His Cool Female Colleague , and an original soundtrack from Evan Call, famously known for his work on Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End and Violet Evergarden .

Yuma Uchida will be taking the lead role as the vampire King Akabara, who has previosuly been heard in massive series like Jujutsu Kaisen as Megumi Fushigoro , Fruits Basket as Kyo Soma, Blue Lock as Reo Mikage, and Banana Fish as Ash Lynx. Taking on the role of Bridget Irving Frostheart, the Black Swan bestowed with the power to slay Akabra is Aino Shimada, best known for her role as Takeko Nishino in Classroom of the Elite , and Bee in the Japanese dub of Bee and Puppycat .

King Akabara’s Story Is A Classic Brought To Life After Decades Of Waiting

Originally published in 2003 in Square Enix’s Monthly Shonen Gangan , The Record of a Fallen Vampire is a beautifully illustrated dark fantasy manga that ran for four years , concluding in 2007 with a sequel series that just began serializing in October 2026, returning to Monthly Shonen Gangan titled The Record of a Fallen Vampire: A Dog’s Song For Dogs . The original series has since been collected into nine volumes, and has been previously licensed by Viz Media and Yen Press for English publication.

The story itself is filled with interpersonal conflict between mortals, half-vampires called dhampirs, and vampires themselves, all through the lens of the ever-omnipotent King Akabara, who has seen the world grow and change through over the course of thousands of years as he tries to track down his queen. His stoic worldview gives the audience an outside looking in perspective to the lives of human beings constantly trying to survive in a world ravaged by the whims of bloodthirsty beings trying to hunt them down.

The old school gothic art style used in the manga creates lush paneling and stunning set pieces the new anime adaptation has potential to draw from as well, meaning that ZERO-G x Liber have the opportunity to create something truly special with their take on The Record of a Fallen Vampire .
